deviation: The draft auto-renews every 12 months with only 30 days' notice to opt out, versus Arcadia's standard of no auto-renewal. The 30-day window is below the playbook's 90-day minimum, so Arcadia could easily miss it and be locked into another year. The draft also has no cap on renewal price increases (playbook: 5%).
suggested_text: This Agreement does not renew automatically. Any extension requires a written agreement signed by both parties.
